reasons: Live test through /api/trials: field restriction cuts EGFR + kidney cancer from 133 to about 15-20, but EGFR + NSCLC drops from 1754 to 1178 (−34%). The lost trials include true EGFR-inhibitor trials (Tarceva/erlotinib, gefitinib, aumolertinib, XL647), so the plan's own recall test fails. The uppercase-only trigger also misfires, because CT.gov matching ignores case.
escalate_note: Choose a disambiguation strategy that keeps recall. Measured options: (a) 'EGFR NOT glomerular' cuts kidney 133→82 and costs NSCLC only 1754→1749; (b) default the condition to the target's disease; (c) expand the gene term with drug names from ChEMBL mechanism data (depends on #61/#27); (d) offer field restriction as an opt-in toggle, not the default. Report before/after counts for NSCLC, kidney and 'cancer'.

required_changes: Follow the #25 consensus: do not freeze ChEMBL values into the demo page arrays. A real-drug row stores only its name and parent ChEMBL ID; structure and properties come from live /api/search or from a src/data/curated file that records ChEMBL ID, release and retrieval date per row.
Use the parent ChEMBL ID and parent properties (imatinib, lapatinib, sorafenib, erlotinib and osimertinib have salt records).
Remove the SDD-#### IDs and screening/hit/lead/preclinical status from real-drug rows.
Status text must be 'ChEMBL max phase 4 (approved)', with no indication implied. Leave out target-variant labels unless they come from ChEMBL mechanism data.
Names that only sound real ('Vemurafenib analog', 'Osimertinib-R', 'EGFR-4G-1') are fictional demo names. Rename them to obvious codes instead of 'correcting' them from ChEMBL.
On /drug, remove the indication and stage claims on the Metformin and Thalidomide rows, or source them.
reasons: Bug confirmed. As written, the plan would create a third, uncited copy of ChEMBL data inside a demo file and ignores the SDD ID collisions.

required_changes: Build DataClassBadge on top of the existing DemoDataNotice/CuratedLabel in data-provenance.tsx.
page-classes.ts needs a 'mixed' class with labels per section (/targets, /clinical/trials).
The /targets text must cover every field shown; the curated label stays on the EGFR panel only.
The sidebar dot must not rely on colour alone, and must work by keyboard and touch. Coordinate with #45.
Optional: a CI check that every route appears in page-classes.ts.
reasons: Addresses the largest user losses directly and does not pre-empt #25.

required_changes: Apply MAX_QUERY_LENGTH to intervention and location, and reject control characters.
Relax the required 'term' (coordinate with #48) so intervention-, condition- or location-only searches work.
Add LastUpdatePostDate to FIELDS. Build the record URL only from a validated NCT ID (^NCT\d{8}$).
URL state includes the active tab, uses router.replace without re-fetch loops, and keeps the #43 stale-request guard.
A partial CSV export says so in a column ('rows 1-N of TOTAL'). Keep the formula-escaping.
reasons: query.intr and query.locn are valid CT.gov v2 parameters. Risk is low as long as the new inputs are validated.

required_changes: Look up mechanisms by parent (parent_molecule_chembl_id, or resolve the hierarchy first). Sorafenib's mechanisms are stored on salt CHEMBL1200485.
Resolve target names with one batched /target.json?target_chembl_id__in= call, and show mechanism_refs as the source.
Activity: set an explicit order_by, show the total count and say the rows are a subset, link to the full ChEMBL list, and do not present potency order as a selectivity profile.
Show the validity flag or the number of flagged rows excluded. Do not drop them silently.
Rate limit (#27 Stage 1) before or with this route. Use Promise.allSettled, maxDuration and timeouts under the Vercel limit.
Fetch on panel expand only.
reasons: The largest loss against AI alone, and within the #27 Stage 1 consensus. As written, the plan would return empty mechanisms for salts and no target names.

required_changes: The CSV includes PMID, DOI, reviewed date and a curated data_status.
New rows meet the #25 curated-row standard (PMID/DOI, excerpt, curator, date verified), are limited to post-osimertinib findings, and bump EGFR_RESISTANCE_REVIEWED.
Plain-language sentences only restate the row: no advice, no new figures, and a person reviews each before merge.
Keep 'Not an exhaustive catalog' and the CIViC link.
reasons: Builds on the verified curated set. The risk of plain-language drift is controlled.

required_changes: Keep the target-drug-CCD mapping in src/data/curated with its source. Ship only EGFR/osimertinib/YY3 unless other pairs are verified the same way.
Build the RCSB query as an AND group (UniProt accession plus non-polymer comp_id), and confirm before merge that the result count is non-zero and correct.
Use a precise label; keep the unfiltered link.
reasons: Link-out only stays inside #27's Stage 2 boundary.

required_changes: No Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * yet (no rate limit exists). Carry CORS over to #73.
Write the docs as 'read-only JSON API, unauthenticated, may change'. Document only the limits the code enforces. Do not repeat the unsourced '100 requests/min' note.
Batch: validate ^CHEMBL\d+$, remove duplicates, allow ≤50, make it mutually exclusive with q, use one molecule.json?molecule_chembl_id__in= call, keep request order, list IDs not found.
Fetch the data release through fetchUpstream with a 24 h TTL, and leave it out if the fetch fails.
reasons: Docs, release and batch are low risk. CORS without a rate limit is a #70/#73 decision.

required_changes: There are two live tools (/search and the Trial Landscape), plus one curated set. Label each by class.
Do not feature the /design assistant or demo metrics.
Keep the start page inside AuthGate (#70 decides public access).
Keep /projects in the sidebar with its demo banner.
reasons: Small fix to a real problem. The plan's premise of three live tools was wrong.

required_changes: Read standard_inchi_key and molecule_hierarchy.parent_chembl_id. Show 'Salt of …' only when the parent differs.
Build the SDF link only from the validated ID, and hide it when there is no structure.
Add InChIKey and parent ID to the search CSV. Coordinate with #38 and #49.
reasons: Small, sourced fields plus a link-out, and #61 and #68 need them.

required_changes: Use pageSize up to 1000, so counts are exact when N ≤ 1000. Above that, label it 'first 1000 of N by relevance, not representative'.
Load on request or after the table, with caching.
Count multi-phase trials as their own bucket. Show top-10 sponsors plus 'other'.
Use the same validated parameters as #60.
reasons: Prevents a biased sample from being read as the whole landscape.

required_changes: Use the parent pref_name (from #66), and skip the link when there is none.
Link only interventions of type DRUG or BIOLOGICAL (add InterventionType), labelled 'Search ChEMBL for …'.
Ship after #47, #48 and #60.
reasons: Cheap and useful. Unfiltered intervention names would produce junk searches.

required_changes: Every definition paraphrases its cited source page, checked at implementation time, and states only sourced thresholds. ALogP and HBA/HBD wording matches #54.
Tooltips work on keyboard focus and tap, with an accessible description and a Source link.
Source URLs point to the exact documentation pages.
reasons: Low risk if definitions are sourced.
